name: v08-a-play-t

checks.id: T1-tablet easy play: no ARM button, the hint says what the sticks do, "touch a stick to take off"

detail.hint: Left stick: up / down and turn. Right stick: fly.
detail.gate: Touch a stick to take off

checks.id: T2-tablet a touch-down off-centre moves no stick; control: v0.7's absolute pad read it as a deflection
T3-tablet a touch starts the motors; the left stick at 60 % climbs about 1.5 m/s; released, it springs to centre
T4-tablet the height holds with no finger on the sticks

T5-tablet the right stick at half forward tilts the drone (angle mode); a touch sample reaches the flight at the frame measured for pointermove and for pointerrawupdate (100 % the same frame); control: a sample held to the next animation frame is measured a frame later
T10-tablet from a touch-down on the pad's outer rim the screen's edge is full stick (roll and pitch back); control: the first grab reached 0.256 / -0.256
T6-tablet the pilot school chip is on screen
T9-tablet the speaker is on screen and nothing at the top prints over anything else; controls: the school chip moved onto the buttons, and onto the credit's text, is caught
T7-tablet no scroll or zoom from the touches
T11-tablet the touch flight (auto-arm, altitude help, grab) replays from its log to the same hash; controls: one LSB and a 0.05 stick twitch in one record change it
T8-tablet no page errors
